highlights.title: US seeks to topple Cuba's government
highlights.summary: And now, in a rather surprising development, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is directly urging Cubans to cooperate with the CIA. Havana has responded by mocking what it calls the Trump administration’s “desperation”.

highlights.title: Live Updates: France Deploys Vast Security Force in Effort to Prevent More Riots
highlights.summary: About 70,000 police and security officers, mobilized ahead of mass protests, will try to avert the arson and looting that shocked the country last weekend.

highlights.title: France braces for new protests
